> Read an isobaric (TMT, TMTpro, iTRAQ, DiLeu) experimental design out of an SDRF, one row per file and annotated channel, in MetaMorpheus's terms, or every reason it was refused.

Wire verb `sdrf isobaric-design` · Python [`pymzlib.sdrf.isobaric_design`][pymzlib.sdrf.isobaric_design]

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | required | — | — | One .sdrf.tsv file. A file that does not exist is a usage error. |
| `kit` | `string` | absent | — | — | The kit the search used, resolved exactly as isobaric kits --kit resolves it: mzLib's IsobaricMassTag.TryGetTagType, whole name, case-insensitive, optionally followed by " on <motif>" (TMT10, tmt10, TMT6-plex, TMT11 on K), never a substring. It is SdrfIsobaricDesignOptions.Tag, which supplies the channel list and their reporter m/z order. A blank or unknown name is a usage error naming the known kits. Absent: mzLib is given no tag and refuses ("No isobaric tag was given"), because the kit is never guessed from the labels. |
| `plex_column` (wire `--plex-column`) | `string` | absent | — | — | SdrfIsobaricDesignOptions.PlexColumn: the column each row's plex is read from, by its exact name. A column not in the SDRF, or a cell that is empty or not available, is mzLib's refusal. Given with no value is a usage error. mzLib needs exactly one of plex-column, plex-file-name-pattern and single-plex; none, or several, is mzLib's refusal, not a usage error. |
| `plex_file_name_pattern` (wire `--plex-file-name-pattern`) | `string` | absent | — | — | SdrfIsobaricDesignOptions.PlexFileNamePattern: a .NET regular expression matched, ignoring case, against each row's file name (the key column's, comment[searched data file] else comment[data file]). The plex is its group named plex, else its first group. A pattern that does not parse, has no group, or does not match a file name is mzLib's refusal. Given with no value is a usage error. |
| `single_plex` (wire `--single-plex`) | `string` | absent | — | — | SdrfIsobaricDesignOptions.SinglePlex: the name of the one plex every file belongs to. Given with no value is a usage error. |
| `condition_columns` (wire `--condition-columns`) | `string` | absent | — | — | SdrfIsobaricDesignOptions.ConditionColumns, exactly as sdrf design takes it: the factor value[...] columns the condition is built from, by exact name, separated by TAB characters, in join order; the condition is their values joined with "_". Absent: mzLib uses the document's only factor column, and refuses a document with several. Given but blank, or with a blank name, is a usage error. |
| `searched_files_stdin` (wire `--searched-files-stdin`) | `flag` | absent | — | — | SdrfIsobaricDesignOptions.SearchedFiles, exactly as sdrf design takes it: stdin holds the files the search will read, one per line, as paths or bare names. Each must be named EXACTLY (case and extension) by some row; rows for other files are dropped and reported in notes; the searched paths become full_path. A search that read X-calib.mzML for an SDRF naming X.raw matches no row: run sdrf restrict first, which writes the searched name into comment[searched data file], the column this reader keys on first. |
| `out` | `path` | absent | — | `a folder; an existing file is refused` | A FOLDER, created when missing (bridge thread 010, PYB-5). mzLib's SdrfIsobaricDesign.WriteTmtDesign writes MetaMorpheus's TmtDesign.txt inside it, replacing one already there: 1-based, one row per file and annotated channel, header SdrfIsobaricDesign.TmtDesignHeader. The file name is MetaMorpheus's (GlobalVariables.TmtExperimentalDesignFileName); mzLib has no constant for it at the pin, so the bridge holds the one copy. Written only when is_valid; a refused design writes nothing and creates no folder, and written is null. A path that is an existing file, or no value, is a usage error, checked before the SDRF is read. |

| `notes` | `string[]` | — | never | What was dropped or filled on the way to a valid design: rows dropped because the search does not read their file, and a file with no row of its own for one of its plex's channels. |

| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns in order. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | Column name to one value per file and annotated channel: files in SDRF row order, then each file's channels in reporter m/z order. |
| `written` | `object` | — | yes: --out was not given, or the design was refused and nothing was written | {path, file_count, record_count} of the TmtDesign.txt written; path is the --out folder joined with TmtDesign.txt. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Eight static caveats. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `full_path` | `string` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricFile.FilePath: the matching searched path when --searched-files-stdin was given, else the file name the key column gives. |
| `plex` | `string` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricFile.Plex: the plex as the declared source gives it (a column cell, a pattern's group, or the single plex). |
| `plex_id` | `int` | — | never | The plex's entry in plex_ids, 1-based: the PlexId mzLib's quantification design gives it. |
| `sample_name` | `string` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricChannel.SampleName: the SDRF source name. |
| `channel` | `string` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricChannel.Label: the channel as the kit spells it (127N), whatever form the SDRF's comment[label] used (TMT127N, NT=TMT127N;AC=...). |
| `condition` | `string` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricChannel.Condition: the condition columns' values joined with _. |
| `biological_replicate` | `int` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricChannel.BiologicalReplicate: 1-based, as the SDRF writes it, never ranked or shifted. |
| `fraction` | `int` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricFile.Fraction: 1-based, as written; 1 when the SDRF has no comment[fraction identifier] column (mzLib's SdrfDesignRules). |
| `technical_replicate` | `int` | — | never | SdrfIsobaricFile.TechnicalReplicate: 1-based, as written; 1 when the SDRF has no comment[technical replicate] column. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | path missing or the file does not exist |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | --kit without a value, or a name mzLib cannot resolve (the same message isobaric kits --kit gives) |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | --plex-column, --plex-file-name-pattern or --single-plex without a value; --condition-columns without a value or with a blank name |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | --out without a value, or naming an existing file (checked before the SDRF is read) |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | mzLib cannot parse the SDRF at all, or the --out folder cannot be created or written |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- 1-BASED, as written. fraction, technical_replicate and biological_replicate are the SDRF's own numbers, as mzLib's SdrfIsobaricDesign keeps them and TmtDesign.txt holds them. sdrf design is 0-based (mzLib's SpectraFileInfo). The split is mzLib's, and the bridge converts neither table: never mix the two without adding or removing 1.
- is_valid = false is an answer: refusals lists every reason at once and the table is empty. A missing kit, no plex source, two plex sources and a bad pattern are refusals, not errors.
- Nothing is guessed. The kit is only the one named, because one kit's labels can be a subset of another's (TMT11 with 131C unannotated reads exactly like TMT10). The plex is only the source declared; comment[sample preparation batch] is often not a plex (in PXD061609 it holds three fractionation arms of one plex).
- Rows are the annotated channels only. mzLib's quantification design (ToExperimentalDesign) carries every kit channel, an unannotated one with biological replicate 0 and no sample; that design is not on the wire.
- A plex is one channel-to-sample map: every file of a plex carries all of its channels, so fractions share their samples.
- Sample type is not read (mzLib MAP-08): every annotated channel is a study sample, a reference or pool channel included.
- --out names a folder. MetaMorpheus reads TmtDesign.txt only from the folder of the first spectra file, and refuses a folder that also holds ExperimentalDesign.tsv. mzLib's writer replaces an existing TmtDesign.txt; MetaMorpheus's own --sdrfDesign never does.
- TMT16 is mzLib's TMTpro 16-plex. MetaMorpheus searches it with its TMT18 label; a TMT16 design is read as is by such a run, with 134C and 135N empty.

### Example

```python
design = pymzlib.sdrf.isobaric_design('PXD008841.subset.sdrf.tsv', kit='TMT10', plex_file_name_pattern=r'TMT_?pool(?<plex>\d+)')
```
